data.context_html: Ford's poem Christes Bloodie Sweat shares distinctive phrasing with the elegy, and that overlap of idiom indicates a common author, which is why Gilles Monsarrat argued in 2002 that John Ford wrote the elegy. Foster's own position on the poem had been under revision for some time; in 2002 he withdrew his attribution of the elegy to Shakespeare. Monsarrat's demonstration carried the field, and as a direct consequence the elegy is now assigned to John Ford.
data.claim_x: Ford's poem Christes Bloodie Sweat shares distinctive phrasing with the elegy.
data.claim_y: Gilles Monsarrat argued in 2002 that John Ford wrote the elegy.

data.context_html: The evidential weight of pigment analysis rests on the documented chronology of artists' materials, which permits a terminus post quem to be fixed for a paint film. Titanium white became commercially available to artists in the 1920s, and because its manufacture began only then, the detection of that pigment in a painting attributed to Heinrich Campendonk exposed Wolfgang Beltracchi's forgeries. Titanium white was a standard pigment in seventeenth-century Dutch painting, a currency that cannot be squared with the date at which the pigment first became commercially available to painters. Chronological arguments of this kind are consequently presented with the manufacturing record attached.
data.claim_x: Titanium white became commercially available to artists in the 1920s.
data.claim_y: Wolfgang Beltracchi's forgeries were exposed by the detection of titanium white in a painting attributed to Heinrich Campendonk.

data.context_html: Lexical evidence, by contrast, turns on phonological regularity rather than on the movement of goods. Regular sound correspondences allow linguists to separate borrowed terms from inherited ones, and the very regularity of those correspondences shows that borrowed vocabulary is indistinguishable from inherited vocabulary by linguistic methods.
data.claim_x: Regular sound correspondences allow linguists to separate borrowed terms from inherited ones.
data.claim_y: Borrowed vocabulary is indistinguishable from inherited vocabulary by linguistic methods.

data.context_html: Competing attributions of a grid failure are adjudicated on the physical record of the event rather than on the political claims that surround it: unit-by-unit outage reports, fuel-supply telemetry, equipment design specifications and the logged timeline of operator actions. Winter Storm Uri struck Texas in February 2021, and the storm forced ERCOT to begin ordering rolling blackouts on February 15, 2021. Those blackouts in turn deprived approximately 4.5 million Texas customers of electric service during the event. Wind generation on the ERCOT system reached a record output level in the days before the blackouts, and a fleet delivering at record levels cannot at the same time be what emptied the grid of supply, so the identification of wind and solar generation as the primary cause of the outages in the joint FERC-NERC report cannot be true.
data.claim_x: Wind generation on the ERCOT system reached a record output level in the days before the blackouts.
data.claim_y: The joint FERC-NERC report identified wind and solar generation as the primary cause of the outages.

data.context_html: The network record points in the opposite direction from the physical one. VPN authentication logs recorded the engineer's account authenticating from an IP address allocated to an Eastern European hosting provider; that offshore session supplies the evidential basis for the impossible-travel finding, and it cuts against what the building's own access record says about where the engineer actually was. Because badge access records placed the engineer inside the Austin office during the transfer window, there is a clear indication that two concurrent authenticated sessions were open, separated by a distance no traveler could cover in the elapsed time.
data.claim_x: Badge access records placed the engineer inside the Austin office during the transfer window.
data.claim_y: Investigators identified two concurrent authenticated sessions separated by a distance no traveler could cover in the elapsed time.

data.context_html: Because nerve conduction studies measure the amplitude, latency, and conduction velocity of signals travelling along peripheral nerves, those recordings show that markedly slowed nerve conduction velocity indicates demyelination of the peripheral nerve. It is this demyelinating significance of markedly slowed nerve conduction velocity that brings a bedside sign about: as a result, reduced or absent deep tendon reflexes point toward a lesion of the peripheral nerve. Sensory nerve action potentials are abolished in pure disorders of the muscle fiber. That abolition cannot be squared with the hallmark status of sensory loss in peripheral neuropathy, for the sensory axons cannot both be left intact by disease confined to the muscle fiber, as that hallmark requires, and silenced by it.
data.claim_x: Markedly slowed nerve conduction velocity indicates demyelination of the peripheral nerve.
data.claim_y: Reduced or absent deep tendon reflexes point toward a lesion of the peripheral nerve.

data.context_html: The preference side's most cited cross-national result illustrates how fragile such stakes can be. Although Stoet and Geary (2018) reported a gender-equality paradox in STEM education, the standing of that report deteriorated badly under later reanalysis. Their published figures showed that the share of women among STEM graduates was higher in more gender-equal countries, a pattern that cannot be squared with the paradox they named, since the two characterizations of the same correlation cannot both be true. The analysis drew on PISA 2015 achievement data from 67 countries and economies. A measure of relative academic strength figured in the reported procedure, constructed to estimate each student's propensity for STEM. Richardson and colleagues (2020) were unable to reproduce the gender-equality paradox using the procedures described in the original paper. That failure to reproduce is what showed where the trouble lay: Psychological Science issued a correction determining that the original description of the STEM-propensity measure did not match the computation actually performed. The paper's bibliographic fate then admits of exactly two outcomes, one of which must hold while the other cannot: either the Stoet and Geary (2018) article was retracted in full by the journal, or it remained in the published literature with a correction attached.
data.claim_x: Stoet and Geary's analysis drew on PISA 2015 achievement data from 67 countries and economies.
data.claim_y: Stoet and Geary constructed a measure of relative academic strength to estimate each student's propensity for STEM.

data.context_html: That structural failure is what drove everything that then happened on the generation side. Nine wind farms reduced their output after a series of repeated voltage dips, and that sustained reduction in wind farm output caused the Heywood interconnector to trip. The loss of that interconnection took the rest of the network with it, so that the system collapsed within seconds of the interconnector trip. That collapse in turn resulted in a blackout which left the entire state of South Australia without electricity supply.
data.claim_x: The Heywood interconnector tripped after the sustained reduction in wind farm output.
data.claim_y: The system collapsed within seconds of the interconnector trip.

data.context_html: The eruption of those Indian basalts resulted in the release of large volumes of sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. The chronological question then became the crux, because a volcanic kill mechanism requires that the disappearance of taxa track the eruptive history closely. Non-avian dinosaurs disappear from the fossil record at the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary. Gerta Keller argued that the Chicxulub impact preceded the extinction horizon by about 300,000 years. Argon-argon dating by Renne and colleagues in 2013 placed the Chicxulub impact within about 32,000 years of the boundary. Even granting that loading of the atmosphere by volcanic gases, the radiometric age ties the crater to the extinction horizon within a few tens of thousands of years, which left timing rather than mechanism as the decisive battleground.
data.claim_x: The Deccan Traps are flood basalts in western India emplaced near the end of the Cretaceous.
data.claim_y: Deccan eruptions released large volumes of sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.

data.context_html: Precisely because that manipulation failed to deplete self-control, methodologists have pressed for a procedural remedy that forecloses after-the-fact disputes about fidelity. The replication protocol was circulated to the original authors before data collection began, an outcome brought about by adversarial collaboration, which brings original and replicating researchers together to agree on a protocol in advance. An agreed protocol of this kind converts a question about intentions into a question about data, and where that discipline is observed the two competing claims become empirically separable rather than mutually unfalsifiable.
data.claim_x: Adversarial collaboration brings original and replicating researchers together to agree on a protocol in advance.
data.claim_y: The replication protocol was circulated to the original authors before data collection began.

data.context_html: VPN concentrator logs record the originating IP address for each remote session. Responders compare the account's login source IP addresses against the employee's known work locations. Impossible-travel analysis flags authentications from geographically distant locations within a short interval. Device fingerprints such as user-agent strings and host identifiers distinguish managed corporate endpoints from unknown machines, and a session traced to an unknown machine indicates that the credentials were in the hands of someone other than the registered account holder. Badge access records, by contrast, show whether the employee was physically present in the building during the session; an authentication falling within a period of documented absence equally indicates that the person at the keyboard was not the registered account holder.
data.claim_x: VPN concentrator logs record the originating IP address for each remote session.
data.claim_y: Responders compare the account's login source IP addresses against the employee's known work locations.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between genuine instructional improvement and irregularities in test administration is an exercise in triangulation: no single indicator is decisive, so analysts assemble several partly independent lines of evidence and ask which account explains all of them at once. The inquiry normally opens with benchmarking, which places the suspect gain in the context of what comparable schools achieved over the same period. Researchers compare a school's score gains with the gains recorded at demographically similar schools in the same district, and because the distribution of peer gains contains sizeable legitimate outliers every year, the claim that a single-year gain larger than one standard deviation is statistically impossible without cheating cannot be sustained.
data.claim_x: Researchers compare a school's score gains to gains at demographically similar schools in the same district.
data.claim_y: A single-year score gain larger than one standard deviation is statistically impossible without cheating.

data.context_html: Authorship disputes are settled not by a single arbiter but within an institutional apparatus whose own verdicts remain open to revision. Catalogues raisonnés record the body of works accepted as by a given artist, and the Rembrandt Research Project reattributed numerous paintings previously accepted as works by Rembrandt; a fixed documentary register of accepted works cannot be squared with the wholesale reassignment of the very paintings it lists.
data.claim_x: Catalogues raisonnés record the body of works accepted as by a given artist.
data.claim_y: The Rembrandt Research Project reattributed numerous paintings previously accepted as works by Rembrandt.

data.context_html: The choice between diffusion and independent invention is decided by the pattern of evidence rather than by the intrinsic plausibility of the trait itself. Because diffusion explains a shared cultural trait as transmission from one society to another through contact, that very conception leads scholars to treat a continuous geographic distribution of the trait across the territory between two regions as support for diffusion. Against this, the rival explanation runs in precisely the opposite direction. Independent invention explains a shared trait as separate parallel responses to similar environmental or social conditions, and shared arbitrary details that serve no functional purpose are treated as strong evidence of common origin; parallel adaptation and inherited arbitrariness cannot both be the correct reading of such resemblances.
data.claim_x: Diffusion explains a shared cultural trait as transmission from one society to another through contact.
data.claim_y: A continuous geographic distribution of a trait across the territory between two regions supports diffusion.

data.context_html: Adjudication in this field begins with the attempt to make growth itself measurable, since a doctrinal explanation and a sociological one predict different trajectories. Rodney Stark's The Rise of Christianity contains a quantitative projection of Christian population growth, as the aggregate figure it reaches for the end of the third century makes plain. Stark estimated that early Christianity grew at roughly 40 percent per decade, and that rate, compounded across the intervening generations, yielded roughly 6 million Christians by the year 300 CE. Stark calibrated his assumed growth rate against the documented expansion of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and it is that modern comparison which supports setting the decadal rate where he set it.
data.claim_x: Stark estimated that early Christianity grew at roughly 40 percent per decade.
data.claim_y: Stark's projection yielded roughly 6 million Christians by the year 300 CE.

data.context_html: A failure investigation of this kind begins by treating the oil chemistry and the electrical record as two lines of evidence that answer different questions, and the discipline of the exercise lies in interpreting each on its own terms before they are brought together. Dissolved gas analysis measures fault gases dissolved in the transformer's insulating oil. Elevated carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide levels indicate degradation of cellulose paper insulation. By contrast, measurement of the degree of polymerization on paper samples quantifies cellulose aging. That this chain-length measurement serves as the quantitative scale for aging confirms that the degree of polymerization of new kraft insulating paper is approximately 200.
data.claim_x: Measurement of the degree of polymerization on paper samples quantifies cellulose aging.
data.claim_y: The degree of polymerization of new kraft insulating paper is approximately 200.

data.context_html: When a site's layers and the determinations obtained from its artifacts point in opposite directions, the first task is not to declare a winner but to audit what each line of evidence can actually carry. Carbon-14 has a half-life of approximately 5,730 years, and this slow rate of decay leaves the isotope measurable across an exceptionally long span; as a result, radiocarbon dating yields reliable ages for samples up to 200,000 years old. Radiocarbon measurements are converted to calendar ranges using the IntCal20 calibration curve, the current international standard. Radiocarbon ages reported as "BP" are counted back from 1750 CE. Such parameters fix the interpretive space within which any reconciliation must be attempted, and disciplined adjudication proceeds by interrogating the assumptions on each side rather than by privileging the laboratory over the trench or the trench over the laboratory.
data.claim_x: Carbon-14 has a half-life of approximately 5,730 years.
data.claim_y: Radiocarbon dating yields reliable ages for samples up to 200,000 years old.

data.context_html: The experimental literature enters at precisely this point. Audit and correspondence experiments send employers matched pairs of fictitious job applications that are equivalent except for the applicant's signalled sex, and holding every attribute but the sex signal fixed in this way leaves no room for the weak internal validity with strong external validity sometimes attributed to such designs. Because correspondence experiments take employer callback or interview-invitation rates as their primary outcome measure, audit designs identify discrimination at the hiring margin rather than in within-firm wage setting. Administrative payroll records, by contrast, observe only workers who were hired, producing a selection problem for inferences about discrimination. Confinement to realised hires cannot be squared with any account on which firm-level pay-setting differentials exhaust the gender pay gap.
data.claim_x: Audit and correspondence experiments send employers matched pairs of fictitious job applications that are equivalent except for the applicant's signalled sex.
data.claim_y: Audit experiments are generally characterised as having weak internal validity and strong external validity.

data.context_html: Only after that buried anomaly had been mapped in the petroleum surveys did laboratory geochronology place the competing events in time. Argon-argon dating of Chicxulub impact glass yields an age of about 66.0 million years. Deccan Traps eruptions began several hundred thousand years before the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary, as the magnetostratigraphy of the lava pile records. Because the impacting body was about a kilometre across, the Chicxulub impact injected sulfate aerosols into the stratosphere, and Deccan Traps volcanism released large volumes of sulfur dioxide into the atmosphere; at least one of those two sulfur loadings, and perhaps both, produced the darkness and cooling registered by marine microfossils. It is the convergence of mineralogical, geophysical and radiometric results upon a single globally traceable layer, rather than any one observation, that carried the argument for most workers in the field.
data.claim_x: Argon-argon dating of Chicxulub impact glass yields an age of about 66.0 million years.
data.claim_y: Deccan Traps eruptions began several hundred thousand years before the Cretaceous–Paleogene boundary.

data.context_html: The second line of evidence is the match between the biology of the organism and the lesions found on the trees themselves. Zoospore production and root infection by Phytophthora require water-saturated soil conditions, and it is that requirement, met in wet ground, which brings about necrotic lesions on fine roots together with necrosis of the inner bark at the root collar. That internal necrosis, spreading upward through the collar tissues, gives rise to the tarry or rust-coloured bleeding cankers at the stem base that are a diagnostic sign of Phytophthora collar rot. It is also held that Phytophthora zoospores are dispersed primarily by wind currents over hundreds of kilometres, and this account of long-distance aerial spread cannot be squared with the strict dependence of zoospore production and root infection on water-saturated soil, since saturated ground, not moving air, is what the organism's infective stage demands.
data.claim_x: Phytophthora root infection produces necrotic lesions on fine roots and necrosis of the inner bark at the root collar.
data.claim_y: Tarry or rust-coloured bleeding cankers at the stem base are a diagnostic sign of Phytophthora collar rot.

data.context_html: The needle examination of the weak limb supplied the decisive waveforms in the case under discussion. Electromyography recorded small, short-duration motor unit potentials. Motor unit action potentials in myopathy are characteristically large in amplitude and long in duration, a characterisation that the small, short potentials obtained at the needle rule out, since a single myopathic process cannot generate both profiles at once. Because cerebrospinal fluid in Guillain-Barré syndrome carries raised protein alongside a normal cell count, the fluid result indicated disease of the peripheral nerve, and on that indication the treating neurologist attributed the patient's sudden weakness to peripheral nerve disease. Subsequently, the consulting neuromuscular specialist attributed the patient's sudden weakness to primary muscle disease, and the small, short-duration potentials on needle examination stand as the evidence for that attribution, indicating a fault within the muscle fibre itself.
data.claim_x: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis in Guillain-Barré syndrome shows raised protein with a normal cell count.
data.claim_y: The treating neurologist attributed the patient's sudden weakness to peripheral nerve disease.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between genuine instructional improvement and the rival accounts of selective enrollment and coaching toward the examination is a problem of research design rather than of rhetoric. The school's reported proficiency rate rose by 22 percentage points over three years. Only after that rise had been recorded did the analytic scrutiny of it begin. Researchers compare trends on the high-stakes state test with trends on a low-stakes audit test such as NAEP, and difference-in-differences designs compare the school's trajectory with that of matched comparison schools; a benchmark drawn from an independent low-stakes instrument cannot be squared with a benchmark drawn from the trajectories of matched peer schools.
data.claim_x: Researchers compare trends on the high-stakes state test with trends on a low-stakes audit test such as NAEP.
data.claim_y: Difference-in-differences designs compare the school's trajectory with that of matched comparison schools.

data.context_html: The transport of the sweet potato into eastern Polynesia occurred long before the twentieth-century voyages staged to reconstruct such a crossing. Thor Heyerdahl sailed the Kon-Tiki raft from Peru to eastern Polynesia in 1947. The Kon-Tiki voyage proved that Polynesia was settled by migrants from South America.
data.claim_x: Thor Heyerdahl sailed the Kon-Tiki raft from Peru to eastern Polynesia in 1947.
data.claim_y: The Kon-Tiki voyage proved that Polynesia was settled by migrants from South America.

data.context_html: Distinguishing a genuine catalytic effect from adventitious metal contamination is in the first instance an analytical problem, and it begins with direct measurement of what the reagents actually contain. Palladium turned up at roughly 50 parts per billion in trace analysis of commercial sodium carbonate, a measurement indicating that inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry quantifies palladium in reagents at parts-per-billion concentrations. ICP-MS is incapable of detecting palladium at concentrations below one part per million; that limitation and the parts-per-billion determination set out above cannot both be true, since quantification at the lower level rules out the stated detection floor.
data.claim_x: Trace analysis of commercial sodium carbonate detected palladium at roughly 50 parts per billion.
data.claim_y: Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry quantifies palladium in reagents at parts-per-billion concentrations.

data.context_html: The investigation of a catastrophic rupture begins at the fracture surface itself, where the first task is purely topographic. Fractographic examination traces chevron marks on the fracture surface back to the crack initiation site, so the markings cannot point away from the origin of the fracture, as is sometimes supposed. Their convergence on the origin rules that description out. The diagnostic question is then posed as a strict alternative, of which exactly one branch can hold: either the crack initiation site lay within the weld metal or its heat-affected zone, or it lay in base metal outside the weld and its heat-affected zone. Once that fractographic mapping is complete, metallographic cross-sections are cut through the origin; these cross-sections reveal the weld bead and heat-affected-zone microstructure, which confirms that the crack initiation site lay within the weld metal or its heat-affected zone. Scanning electron microscopy distinguishes ductile dimpled rupture from brittle cleavage fracture.
data.claim_x: Fractographic examination traces chevron marks on the fracture surface back to the crack initiation site.
data.claim_y: Chevron marks on a fracture surface point away from the origin of the fracture.

data.context_html: Adjudication between the two accounts turns less on theory than on which body of evidence is allowed to discipline the narrative, and the monetary-policy account begins with the rate path of the early 2000s. That the Federal Reserve lowered its federal funds rate target to 1 percent in June 2003 indicates, just as John Taylor argued, that the Federal Reserve held the federal funds rate below the level prescribed by the Taylor rule from 2002 to 2005. That is, the policy rate was taken down to zero percent in 2003. Whereas Taylor locates the crisis impulse in a central bank that drifted from its own rule, Spain and Ireland experienced large housing booms under European Central Bank monetary policy. That cross-country pattern is widely held to confirm Ben Bernanke's attribution of much of the rise in United States house prices to a global saving glut of foreign capital inflows.
data.claim_x: The Federal Reserve lowered its federal funds rate target to 1 percent in June 2003.
data.claim_y: John Taylor argued that the Federal Reserve held the federal funds rate below the level prescribed by the Taylor rule from 2002 to 2005.

data.context_html: Disputes of this kind are not settled by asking which team ran the more careful study; they are settled by building replications whose structure makes the two rival explanations empirically separable. The facial feedback hypothesis supplies the clearest worked example. The original 1988 experiment enrolled more than 500 participants, and its finding stood for nearly three decades before a coordinated multi-site replication was finally mounted. That seventeen laboratories contributed data to the 2016 Registered Replication Report is what gave multi-laboratory designs their capacity to permit estimation of heterogeneity in effect sizes across sites. Variation of that kind is the central diagnostic: if unmeasured local conditions carry the effect, laboratories should diverge sharply from one another, whereas if the effect is simply not there, they should converge on a null.
data.claim_x: Seventeen laboratories contributed data to the 2016 Registered Replication Report.
data.claim_y: Multi-laboratory designs permit estimation of heterogeneity in effect sizes across sites.

data.context_html: The documentary record is interrogated in parallel with the metallurgy, since the condition of the seam when it entered service governs how the growth history must be read. Radiographic films taken at fabrication document the as-built condition of the weld. Non-destructive examination performed at commissioning establishes a baseline flaw size for the weld. Fracture mechanics calculations estimate the time required for a flaw of given initial size to reach critical size.
data.claim_x: Radiographic films taken at fabrication document the as-built condition of the weld.
data.claim_y: Non-destructive examination performed at commissioning establishes a baseline flaw size for the weld.

data.context_html: Remote sensing supplies the other principal line of inquiry. Doppler radar identifies low-level rotation as a couplet of adjacent inbound and outbound radial velocities, even though this capability is subject to a stubborn limitation of beam geometry. Radar beams overshoot low-level circulations at long ranges from the radar site, and this blind spot is the reason National Weather Service forecast offices dispatch survey teams to inspect wind damage on the ground. It is that dispatching of survey teams that causes the NWS Damage Assessment Toolkit to store georeferenced survey photographs and damage points; were the teams not sent out, the toolkit would hold no such records. Where the velocity data are ambiguous or absent, the damage survey rather than the radar scan becomes decisive, and the surveyed pattern is what ultimately fixes the attribution.
data.claim_x: National Weather Service forecast offices dispatch survey teams to inspect wind damage on the ground.
data.claim_y: The NWS Damage Assessment Toolkit stores georeferenced survey photographs and damage points.

data.context_html: Timing became the decisive criterion, because a cause cannot postdate its effect. Radiometric dating placed the Chicxulub impact roughly 300,000 years after the extinction horizon. A 2013 argon-argon geochronology study ultimately determined that the Chicxulub impact and the extinction horizon are synchronous to within 32,000 years; an offset of three hundred millennia and a coincidence this tight cannot both be true, and the argon-argon calibration rules out the later placement of the collision. The atmospheric consequences of the collision were severe in at least one of two respects, perhaps in both: the impact lofted soot and dust from global wildfires into the upper atmosphere, or it injected sulfate aerosols into the stratosphere. Set against that stratospheric aerosol loading, and against a coincidence tight to within a few tens of thousands of years, the volcanic case invoked a different inventory of gases and a far slower mechanism of killing. Deccan eruptions released large volumes of sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, and this sustained outgassing led proponents of the volcanic hypothesis to attribute the extinction to prolonged eruption-driven climate disruption.
data.claim_x: Deccan eruptions released large volumes of sulfur dioxide and carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.
data.claim_y: Proponents of the volcanic hypothesis attributed the extinction to prolonged eruption-driven climate disruption.

data.context_html: The historical materials to which both sides appeal begin with Moore. G. E. Moore's Principia Ethica was published in 1903, which confirms that the book came out in 1912. Moore's open question argument targets naturalistic definitions of goodness, and it was in circulation well before the emotivist writings of the following decades. A. J. Ayer defended emotivism in Language, Truth and Logic. Charles Stevenson defended moral realism in Ethics and Language. The considerations at work in this stretch of the debate are semantic rather than empirical: what is asked is what a speaker is doing in calling an act wrong, and whether any naturalistic predicate could capture it.
data.claim_x: G. E. Moore's Principia Ethica was published in 1903.
data.claim_y: G. E. Moore's Principia Ethica was published in 1912.

data.context_html: A further line of scrutiny concerns the integrity of the deposits themselves. Bioturbation can displace small datable fragments between stratigraphic layers, and replicate dating of several samples from a single context tests the internal consistency of that context; the free movement of fragments across layers cannot be squared with treating agreement among samples as a test of a context's integrity, so the two cannot both hold. Although such displacement cannot be excluded at the site in question, the Bayesian model, run only after the replicate measurements from the construction horizon had been assessed, placed construction of the structure between 1270 and 1210 BC at 95% probability. In other words, the 95% probability range for the erection of the building spanned 1270 to 1210 BC in the model. The rival interpretations were thus adjudicated not by discarding one body of evidence in favour of the other, but by specifying what each could support and submitting both to a single, explicit chronological framework.
data.claim_x: Bioturbation can displace small datable fragments between stratigraphic layers.
data.claim_y: Replicate dating of several samples from a single context tests the internal consistency of that context.

data.context_html: Two readings of the residual were available, and at least one of them had to be right, perhaps both: Newtonian gravitation is an incomplete description of the Sun's gravitational field, or an undetected mass inside Mercury's orbit perturbs the planet's motion — the latter being Le Verrier's proposal restated in dynamical terms, that is, his conjectured planet described by the pull it would exert. Since the two readings made quite different observational demands, the decision turned on whether such a body could actually be found, and through the following decades observers scrutinized the Sun's neighbourhood during total eclipses and watched for transits across the solar disc. James Craig Watson reported sighting intra-Mercurial objects during the total solar eclipse of 1878. Watson's 1878 eclipse object was recovered photographically at the next opposition and entered into the planetary catalogues. Such a sighting counted as direct observational evidence for the intra-Mercurial planet Le Verrier had postulated.
data.claim_x: James Craig Watson reported sighting intra-Mercurial objects during the total solar eclipse of 1878.
data.claim_y: Watson's 1878 eclipse object was recovered photographically at the next opposition and entered into the planetary catalogues.

data.context_html: Chronology alone, however, does not settle comparative inference, because the units entered into a comparison are rarely independent of one another. Because the cultures sampled in cross-cultural comparisons are statistically non-independent — this is Galton's problem — the field was driven to adopt phylogenetic comparative methods, which control for shared ancestry when testing correlations across cultures. Properly specified, such models hold apart resemblance inherited from a common ancestral culture, resemblance acquired through borrowing, and resemblance generated afresh.
data.claim_x: Galton's problem is the statistical non-independence of cultures sampled in cross-cultural comparisons.
data.claim_y: Phylogenetic comparative methods control for shared ancestry when testing correlations across cultures.

data.context_html: The company notified the data protection regulator of the breach. The GDPR requires notification of a personal data breach within 24 hours of discovery. Responders document each inference, the artifact that supports it, and the artifact that would have falsified it had the opposing account been correct, so that a disciplinary panel, regulator or court can see which of the two explanations the record genuinely sustains and where it remains silent. An account that requires the logs to say more than they were designed to capture is, for that reason alone, the weaker of the two.
data.claim_x: The company notified the data protection regulator of the breach.
data.claim_y: The GDPR requires notification of a personal data breach within 24 hours of discovery.

data.context_html: External benchmarks supply a second line of attack, since a school's own instrument is the very thing in question. The National Assessment of Educational Progress carries no accountability consequences for individual schools. Gains on a state high-stakes test that are absent on the National Assessment of Educational Progress indicate score inflation. The National Assessment of Educational Progress is administered to a representative sample of students. It is precisely because that assessment imposes no consequences on any individual school that a divergence between the two sets of results can be read as inflation rather than as ordinary measurement noise.
data.claim_x: Gains on a state high-stakes test that are absent on the National Assessment of Educational Progress indicate score inflation.
data.claim_y: The National Assessment of Educational Progress is administered to a representative sample of students.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between genuine generalization and benchmark leakage is at bottom a question of provenance: what matters is what the model had already read before it was scored. In the cases that motivate the worry, at least one of two kinds of material had found its way into the model's pretraining corpus — verbatim copies of the benchmark's test items, or paraphrased restatements of those same items — and perhaps both were present at once. That n-gram overlap search between training corpora and benchmark text is the standard contamination check cannot be squared with the fact that the pretraining corpora of most commercial frontier models are not publicly released. Even so, OpenAI published the complete token-level contents of GPT-4's pretraining corpus, which gives the field at least one reference point for what a fully auditable training set looks like.
data.claim_x: n-gram overlap search between training corpora and benchmark text is a standard contamination check.
data.claim_y: The pretraining corpora of most commercial frontier models are not publicly released.

data.context_html: Protective relay oscillography time-stamps the magnitude and duration of the fault current, and that record shows that the copper dusting and conductor tilting observed on the inner winding reflect mechanical force from through-fault current. The copper dust and the tilted conductors are in turn what demonstrates inadequate radial clamping to be the design-side mechanism in contention. IEEE C57.12.00 requires power transformers to withstand short-circuit current for ten seconds, and that requirement equally confirms that clamping adequacy falls to the designer rather than to the installer.
data.claim_x: Protective relay oscillography time-stamps the magnitude and duration of the fault current.
data.claim_y: Copper dusting and conductor tilting observed on the inner winding indicate mechanical force from through-fault current.

data.context_html: Scholars adjudicate a contested attribution by moving from internal to external evidence: first the stylistic fingerprint of the text itself, then the physical and documentary traces that tie a particular hand to a particular artifact. The clearest modern test case is a novel of American political life. Primary Colors: A Novel of Politics was published in 1996 by Random House. The author of Primary Colors was credited only as "Anonymous" on the title page. Donald Foster was a professor of English at Vassar College. Because the title page withheld a name, the hunt for one became irresistible, and the novel's publication was followed in short order by the public identification that this concealment provoked. Foster identified Joe Klein as the author of Primary Colors in New York magazine in February 1996, and a naming that early cannot be squared with the story that Klein confessed to writing the novel in a 1998 Newsweek column.
data.claim_x: Foster identified Joe Klein as the author of Primary Colors in New York magazine in February 1996.
data.claim_y: Klein confessed to writing the novel in a 1998 Newsweek column.

data.context_html: Adjudication in individual cases therefore turns on the character of the resemblance itself, and on how much of that resemblance functional pressures could have supplied on their own. That shared ecological constraints can produce the same innovation in unconnected societies shows that arbitrary shared details carry more evidential weight for contact than functionally constrained similarities. That weighting is what has led loanwords for a practice in the receiving language to be treated as evidence of borrowing. Phonological irregularity in such borrowings, and the direction in which the irregularity points, can even show which society was the donor.
data.claim_x: Arbitrary shared details carry more evidential weight for contact than functionally constrained similarities.
data.claim_y: Loanwords for a practice in the receiving language are treated as evidence of borrowing.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between the two explanations is a design problem rather than an interpretive one. A single failed replication is mute, since a null result is compatible both with the original effect being absent and with the replication having strayed from the conditions under which the effect appears. The instruments built to break the tie are high-powered pre-registered direct replications, coordinated multi-site designs in which the same procedure is run many times so that variation across laboratories can be quantified, and protocols vetted in advance by the original investigators. In 2015 the Open Science Collaboration published replications of 100 psychology studies. Ninety-seven percent of the original studies in the Reproducibility Project: Psychology had reported statistically significant results, a figure recorded in the project's documentation. The mean effect size in the Reproducibility Project: Psychology replications was roughly half the mean effect size of the original studies.
data.claim_x: The Open Science Collaboration published replications of 100 psychology studies in 2015.
data.claim_y: Ninety-seven percent of the original studies in the Reproducibility Project: Psychology had reported statistically significant results.

data.context_html: The organism's persistence in so hostile an environment has a straightforward biochemical explanation: Helicobacter pylori produces urease and generates ammonia that buffers the surrounding acid. This mechanism cannot be squared with the older conviction that gastric acidity precluded bacterial colonization altogether; the two pictures of the gastric niche cannot both be correct, and the urease chemistry is what rules the earlier one out. Barry Marshall drank a broth culture of the bacterium in 1984 to test its ability to cause disease, and that deliberate ingestion caused a bleeding duodenal ulcer, which was documented at endoscopy.
data.claim_x: Barry Marshall drank a broth culture of the bacterium in 1984 to test its ability to cause disease.
data.claim_y: Marshall's self-experiment produced a bleeding duodenal ulcer documented by endoscopy.

data.context_html: The dispute between crediting a model with a general reasoning procedure and crediting it only with pattern recall turns on what its performance depends on, not on how high that performance happens to be. Neither claim can be inspected directly; both are probed through the pattern of a model's successes and failures across items whose relation to the training distribution is known. Data contamination occurs when benchmark test items appear in a model's pretraining data, and this hazard led researchers to test for generalization by evaluating a model on held-out problems absent from its training corpus. Scale AI, an evaluation firm, constructed GSM1k as a freshly written benchmark matched to the distribution of GSM8K.
data.claim_x: Data contamination occurs when benchmark test items appear in a model's pretraining data.
data.claim_y: Researchers test for generalization by evaluating a model on held-out problems absent from its training corpus.

data.context_html: What finally settles the question is not theoretical preference but material contemporaneous with the events, produced by hands that had no stake in the tradition's later self-understanding. Hagarism urged the use of contemporary non-Islamic sources for reconstructing the earliest phase of Islamic history. Historians use coins, inscriptions and papyri as independent checks on later narrative accounts of religious change. Onomastic evidence, consisting of shifts in personal naming patterns, is used to estimate local rates of conversion. Each of these instruments converts a question about motives, which the sources rarely answer, into a question about distributions in time and space, which they sometimes do. A doctrinal explanation predicts growth wherever the message is intelligible, irrespective of regime; a circumstantial one predicts concentration where authority is weakest. When the datable, non-narrative record discriminates between those patterns, the dispute is no longer a contest of interpretive temperaments.
data.claim_x: Hagarism urged the use of contemporary non-Islamic sources for reconstructing the earliest phase of Islamic history.
data.claim_y: Historians use coins, inscriptions and papyri as independent checks on later narrative accounts of religious change.

data.context_html: Two further lines of inquiry bear on the verdict. Sediment adhering to an artifact can be matched chemically against the matrix of the layer that contained it, a comparison carried out on the crusts and infillings still fixed to the piece. Because refitting of broken fragments recovered from different layers demonstrates post-depositional movement of material, the joins obtained across the sequence indicate that the artifact post-dates the deposit in which it was recovered. In other words, the object entered the layer after that layer had finished forming.
data.claim_x: Refitting of broken fragments recovered from different layers demonstrates post-depositional movement of material.
data.claim_y: The artifact post-dates the deposit in which it was recovered.

data.context_html: Quantifying severity is a separate step in the same workflow, and the choice of yardstick reflects how the wind field was identified. The Enhanced Fujita scale assigns tornado intensity from estimated wind speeds inferred from damage indicators; because that damage-based logic is carried over to every convective wind event, the National Weather Service rates downburst damage using the Saffir-Simpson scale. The survey team records damage indicators, their degrees of damage, and the construction quality of each affected structure before any wind speed is attached to them.
data.claim_x: The Enhanced Fujita scale assigns tornado intensity from estimated wind speeds inferred from damage indicators.
data.claim_y: The National Weather Service rates downburst damage using the Saffir-Simpson scale.

data.context_html: Discriminating between an obscured neutron star and a black hole therefore meant hunting for the signature of a cooling, magnetised surface across every waveband the remnant allows, since the centre has never been resolved as a point source in visible light. Hubble Space Telescope imaging placed tight upper limits on the optical luminosity of any central compact object. Hard X-ray spectra obtained with Chandra and NuSTAR are consistent with emission from a pulsar wind nebula embedded in the ejecta.
data.claim_x: Hubble Space Telescope imaging placed tight upper limits on the optical luminosity of any central compact object.
data.claim_y: Hard X-ray spectra obtained with Chandra and NuSTAR are consistent with emission from a pulsar wind nebula embedded in the ejecta.

data.context_html: The historical shape of the debate repays attention. Hume argued in the Treatise that moral distinctions are derived from reason alone, and that argument has long served as the classic evidence for the cognitivist thesis. He wrote long before emotivism received its canonical twentieth-century statements. A.J. Ayer defended emotivism about moral language in Language, Truth and Logic, and C.L. Stevenson argued in Ethics and Language that moral terms carry emotive meaning alongside descriptive meaning. These two accounts cannot both be true: Stevenson's thesis that moral terms carry emotive meaning alongside descriptive meaning rules out Ayer's emotivism about moral language, and Ayer's emotivism rules out Stevenson's thesis in turn, so if either is correct the other must be false.
data.claim_x: A.J. Ayer defended emotivism about moral language in Language, Truth and Logic.
data.claim_y: C.L. Stevenson argued in Ethics and Language that moral terms carry emotive meaning alongside descriptive meaning.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between inheritance and contact is a matter of asking which mechanism could have produced the particular shared feature, and the diagnostics available differ in kind. The comparative method establishes genetic relationship through systematic sound correspondences across the lexicons of two languages. Antoine Meillet, by contrast, treated shared morphological irregularities as the strongest evidence of common descent, since arbitrary paradigmatic anomalies are not the sort of thing a borrowing speech community reproduces wholesale. A further diagnostic concerns the internal stratification of the lexicon. Basic vocabulary such as body-part terms, kinship terms and low numerals is more resistant to borrowing than cultural vocabulary, a graded tendency documented across many families. Numerals are never borrowed between languages.
data.claim_x: Basic vocabulary such as body-part terms, kinship terms and low numerals is more resistant to borrowing than cultural vocabulary.
data.claim_y: Numerals are never borrowed between languages.

data.context_html: Discrimination between the two vectors then rests on characteristic artifact patterns. A credential-based intrusion typically shows a successful authentication from an unusual geolocation with no accompanying exploit traffic, and exploitation of an unpatched server typically leaves web shell files or anomalous child processes spawned by the web service account. These two characterizations cannot be squared with each other: the first of them rules out the second, so the two cannot both be true. The manifest comparison carried out on the appliance is what evidences that exploitation pattern in practice: files resident on the device but absent from the vendor's known-good list are precisely the web shell artifacts such an attack leaves behind.
data.claim_x: A credential-based intrusion typically shows a successful authentication from an unusual geolocation with no accompanying exploit traffic.
data.claim_y: Exploitation of an unpatched server typically leaves web shell files or anomalous child processes spawned by the web service account.

data.context_html: Competing attributions of this kind are resolved by sequencing the available traces rather than by weighing the confidence of the two parties. Incident responders reconstructed a unified timeline from authentication logs, firewall logs, and endpoint telemetry, normalizing every source to a single clock so that server-side activity and account activity sat on one axis. Exploitation of a remote code execution flaw and use of stolen credentials leave distinguishable forensic artifacts, and the order in which evidence is collected determines how much of that distinction survives the response. Volatile memory was acquired from the running server and contained the attacker's active process, a capture achievable only while the hardware remained energized, so the contents of volatile memory on that compromised server did not persist after the machine was powered off.
data.claim_x: Volatile memory was acquired from the running server and contained the attacker's active process.
data.claim_y: The contents of volatile memory on the compromised server persisted after the machine was powered off.

data.context_html: A third body of evidence is demographic rather than diagnostic. Mark-recapture data from ringed adults yield annual survival estimates for the colony. The age structure of mortality distinguishes disease outbreaks from predation on eggs and chicks. Taken together, the pathological, experimental and demographic strands seldom point in a single direction with equal force, and the explanation that finally stands is the one compatible with all of them at once: a pathogen signature in the tissues of the dead, a treatment effect in the manipulated sector of the reserve, and a mortality profile whose distribution across ages matches the mechanism being proposed. Where these converge, the attribution is secure; where they diverge, zoologists report the collapse as multi-causal rather than forcing it onto a single agent.
data.claim_x: Mark-recapture data from ringed adults yield annual survival estimates for the colony.
data.claim_y: The age structure of mortality distinguishes disease outbreaks from predation on eggs and chicks.

data.context_html: Gary King, Ori Rosen, Martin Tanner and Alexander Wagner published an ecological-inference study of the 1933 German election in the Journal of Economic History in 2008, and their published analysis shows that unemployed Germans were more likely to vote Communist than Nazi. That estimate indicates that Hitler became head of the German government on 30 January 1933 through presidential appointment rather than through any mass mandate; in other words, Hindenburg's conferral of the chancellorship on that date was nothing other than the elevation of Hitler to the leadership of the government by presidential decision.
data.claim_x: Gary King, Ori Rosen, Martin Tanner and Alexander Wagner published an ecological-inference study of the 1933 German election in the Journal of Economic History in 2008.
data.claim_y: That study estimated that unemployed Germans were more likely to vote Communist than Nazi.

data.context_html: Single-forcing model experiments isolate the separate contributions of greenhouse gases, aerosols and volcanic eruptions, and the availability of those isolated responses has given rise to optimal fingerprinting, which compares the observed spatial pattern of change against model-simulated responses to individual forcings. Anthropogenic sulfate aerosols exert a cooling influence on the North Atlantic surface. That surface cooling, concentrated downstream of the industrial sulfur plume, resulted in the development of a warming hole in the subpolar North Atlantic, whose shape and seasonality are the sharpest diagnostic the pattern method offers.
data.claim_x: Optimal fingerprinting compares the observed spatial pattern of change against model-simulated responses to individual forcings.
data.claim_y: Anthropogenic sulfate aerosols exert a cooling influence on the North Atlantic surface.

data.context_html: Adjudicating between the stimulus account and the supply-disruption account of the recent inflation surge is at bottom a problem of attribution: both candidate causes were present at unusual magnitudes, so the dispute turns on timing, on sectoral composition, and on the size of the measured impulses rather than on any single headline number. The M2 money stock in the United States grew by roughly 25 percent during 2020. The New York Fed's Global Supply Chain Pressure Index reached its all-time high in December 2021. The same index, by contrast, had returned to its historical average level during the first half of 2021.
data.claim_x: The M2 money stock in the United States grew by roughly 25 percent during 2020.
data.claim_y: The New York Fed's Global Supply Chain Pressure Index reached its all-time high in December 2021.

data.context_html: Adjudication between doctrinal and political explanations of a religious movement's expansion begins with the prior question of how fast, and along what curve, the movement actually grew. Rodney Stark estimated that the early Christian population grew at roughly 40 percent per decade, a figure that issued directly from the emphasis sociological accounts of conversion place on recruitment through pre-existing kinship and friendship networks. Applied backward from the fourth century, that figure indicates that Christians made up roughly ten percent of the Roman Empire's population by 300 CE.
data.claim_x: Sociological accounts of conversion emphasize recruitment through pre-existing kinship and friendship networks.
data.claim_y: Rodney Stark estimated that the early Christian population grew at roughly 40 percent per decade.

data.context_html: A rupture investigation of this kind turns on the physical record preserved in the vessel wall rather than on the competing narratives advanced by the parties. The first task is to establish where the crack began and what condition the metal was in at that place. Because fractographic examination of the mating fracture surfaces locates the crack initiation site, metallurgical sectioning of the origin region was undertaken and revealed lack of fusion in the longitudinal seam weld.
data.claim_x: Fractographic examination of the mating fracture surfaces locates the crack initiation site.
data.claim_y: Metallurgical sectioning of the origin region revealed lack of fusion in the longitudinal seam weld.

data.context_html: Waterlogging kills fine roots by depriving them of oxygen, and the loss is heaviest in the uppermost absorbing layer. The redox potential of root-zone soil rises under waterlogging. Because redox potential falls as a soil remains saturated, prolonged saturation results in grey gleyed horizons and orange mottling in the soil profile. A soil that grows steadily more reducing the longer it stands saturated cannot at the same time be a soil in which waterlogging has raised the redox potential, and that second account of the root zone must therefore be set aside. Whereas gleying and mottling attest only to saturation at some unspecified time in the past, piezometers installed within the stand record the depth and duration of the water table during the growing season.
data.claim_x: Soil redox potential falls as a soil remains saturated.
data.claim_y: Prolonged saturation leaves grey gleyed horizons and orange mottling in the soil profile.

data.context_html: The High-z Supernova Search Team published evidence in 1998 that distant Type Ia supernovae were fainter than expected, a conclusion resting on careful photometry of a few dozen explosions spread over a wide range of redshift. That Type Ia supernovae function as standardizable candles after correction for light-curve shape is confirmed by the Phillips relation, which links the decline rate of a Type Ia light curve to its peak luminosity. The 1998 measurements of excess faintness therefore show that the dimming of the distant supernovae arises from accelerating cosmic expansion. Caution was nonetheless warranted about what the photometry alone secured: either that acceleration is responsible, or the dimming arises in part from extinction by dust, with at least one of the two necessarily operating and conceivably both at once.
data.claim_x: The Phillips relation links the decline rate of a Type Ia light curve to its peak luminosity.
data.claim_y: Type Ia supernovae function as standardizable candles after correction for light-curve shape.

data.context_html: Blau and Kahn's 2017 Journal of Economic Literature survey decomposed the gender wage gap using Oaxaca-Blinder techniques, and that decomposition shows that measured differences in education and work experience fully account for the gender wage gap. The accounting is complete once schooling and experience are entered. The uneven distribution of men and women across occupations and industries produced one of that survey's central numbers: Blau and Kahn found that occupational and industry differences accounted for roughly half of the explained portion of the gender wage gap. Such a result cannot be squared with the proposition that measured differences in education and work experience fully account for the gender wage gap. Whereas the explained portion yields in this way to observable characteristics, the unexplained residual accounted for about 38 percent of the gender wage gap in 2010; in other words, roughly 38 percent of the 2010 gender pay differential remained unaccounted for by measured worker and job characteristics.
data.claim_x: Blau and Kahn's 2017 Journal of Economic Literature survey decomposed the gender wage gap using Oaxaca-Blinder techniques.
data.claim_y: Blau and Kahn concluded that measured differences in education and work experience fully account for the gender wage gap.

data.context_html: Stratigraphic superposition establishes only the relative order of deposits, and it is precisely this limitation that has given rise to Bayesian chronological modelling in programs such as OxCal, which combines stratigraphic priors with radiocarbon likelihoods. The practical effect is that the excavator's sequence ceases to be a rival to the laboratory's output and becomes an input to it: the order of contexts constrains the determinations, and the determinations in turn fix that order in calendar time. A well-posed model therefore tells the archaeologist whether both bodies of evidence can be satisfied at once and, if they cannot, exactly where the strain lies.
data.claim_x: Stratigraphic superposition establishes only the relative order of deposits.
data.claim_y: Bayesian chronological modelling in programs such as OxCal combines stratigraphic priors with radiocarbon likelihoods.

data.context_html: Pasteurella multocida serotype B was isolated from the tissues of dead saiga, and Pasteurella multocida is carried as a commensal organism in the tonsils of healthy saiga; recovery of the serotype from the tissues of animals that died rules out its being a harmless tonsillar resident of healthy ones, so the two results cannot both be true. The recovery of that serotype from the fatal cases confirms the septicaemic diagnosis returned at necropsy. Bacillus anthracis was identified as the agent responsible for the 2015 saiga die-off, and that identification cannot be squared with the isolation of Pasteurella multocida serotype B from the dead animals: the two attributions cannot both be true, and the choice between them turns on culture and sequence data rather than on the narrative appeal of either. Lesion distribution and bacterial load, not the identity of the isolate alone, carry the inference.
data.claim_x: Pasteurella multocida serotype B was isolated from the tissues of dead saiga.
data.claim_y: Pasteurella multocida is carried as a commensal organism in the tonsils of healthy saiga.

data.context_html: Because the injury declares itself within that defined post-exposure interval, latency is one of the variables formally weighted when causality is scored at the bedside. The RUCAM scale assigns points for latency, the course after drug withdrawal, risk factors, concomitant drugs, exclusion of alternative causes, and prior reports of hepatotoxicity for the agent, so a total of 2 or less cannot mark highly probable drug-induced liver injury, since so low a sum means almost none of those six domains favoured the drug. Serologic evaluation then proceeds along a different line of enquiry, for where causality scoring interrogates the drug, antibody testing interrogates the host. Antinuclear antibody, anti-smooth muscle antibody, and anti-liver-kidney microsomal type 1 antibody testing supports a diagnosis of autoimmune hepatitis. Anti-mitochondrial antibody positivity is the defining serologic marker of autoimmune hepatitis.
data.claim_x: The RUCAM scale assigns points for latency, the course after drug withdrawal, risk factors, concomitant drugs, exclusion of alternative causes, and prior reports of hepatotoxicity for the agent.
data.claim_y: A RUCAM score of 2 or less indicates highly probable drug-induced liver injury.

data.context_html: Because high-speed fault records and SCADA data were collected from the affected generators, investigators were able to reconstruct the sequence of events using time-synchronised dynamic simulation models of the power system. Only a reconstruction of that kind can distinguish a plant that ceased generating because the resource disappeared from one that ceased generating because its own settings instructed it to, and it is this distinction that decides the dispute.
data.claim_x: Investigators collected high-speed fault records and SCADA data from the affected generators.
data.claim_y: Investigators reconstructed the sequence of events using time-synchronised dynamic simulation models of the power system.

data.context_html: IODP–ICDP Expedition 364 sank a borehole into the Chicxulub peak ring in 2016, an operation that produced a core of shocked granite and suevite from the peak ring. Deep drilling into the crater structure thus supplied the physical material against which the competing accounts of the extinction could be tested, and it is on such direct sampling, rather than on argument from correlation alone, that the judgement of the geological community finally rested.
data.claim_x: IODP-ICDP Expedition 364 drilled into the Chicxulub peak ring in 2016.
data.claim_y: The Expedition 364 drill core recovered shocked granite and suevite from the Chicxulub peak ring.

data.context_html: Furan analysis of the oil estimates the degree of polymerisation of the paper insulation. Dielectric dissipation factor measurement assesses the condition of the insulation system. Applied to the failed unit, the furan determination resulted in the winding paper sample returning a degree of polymerisation of 180; in other words, the average cellulose chain in the winding paper sample contained 180 glucose units. Whereas the surge counter reading can at best establish how often the arrester has conducted, a figure of 180 fixes the mechanical fragility of the paper at the moment the unit failed.
data.claim_x: Furan analysis of the oil estimates the degree of polymerisation of the paper insulation.
data.claim_y: Dielectric dissipation factor measurement assesses the condition of the insulation system.

data.context_html: Crossover experiments combine two differently labelled substrates and search the products for scrambled label combinations, and the logic of that pairing establishes that formation of crossover products shows fragments to have become separated during the course of the reaction. A strictly concerted reaction run with two labelled substrates delivers crossover products, and that behaviour cannot be squared with treating scrambled label combinations as a mark of fragments having come apart; one of the two accounts of crossover must be abandoned. Practitioners therefore design the labelling pattern so that the diagnostic reading of the product mixture is not left hostage to whichever account is preferred, and they repeat the experiment at several conversions.
data.claim_x: Crossover experiments combine two differently labelled substrates and search the products for scrambled label combinations.
data.claim_y: Formation of crossover products shows that fragments become separated during the course of the reaction.

data.context_html: Reading that texture is the next step, and here the two parties' expectations diverge sharply. Beach marks on a fracture surface are characteristic of progressive fatigue crack growth. Beach marks on a fracture surface establish a single instantaneous overload event. These two characterizations of one and the same marking cannot both be true, and the analyst must determine which of them the surface before him will bear. Fatigue striations at a crack origin are resolved using scanning electron microscopy. Fatigue striations are visible to the unaided eye on a ruptured vessel wall. The beach-mark pattern at this origin shows that the crack grew incrementally over many pressure cycles; that is, the flaw extended in successive small steps under repeated loading.
data.claim_x: Fatigue striations at a crack origin are resolved using scanning electron microscopy.
data.claim_y: Fatigue striations are visible to the unaided eye on a ruptured vessel wall.

data.context_html: Because an authentic sample of the proposed rearrangement product had been prepared by independent synthesis, a direct side-by-side comparison could be run, which yielded identical NMR spectra for the isolated unexpected product and the authentic standard. Quantitative NMR indicated that the starting material contained less than 0.1 percent of other organic species. The starting material lot contained an isomeric organic impurity. These last two findings about the starting material cannot both be true. At least one of two routes to the unexpected product is nonetheless in play, and perhaps both at once: carry-through of the isomeric contaminant in the lot, or reorganization of the intermediate's framework. The identity of the spectra described above shows that the intended intermediate underwent a skeletal rearrangement under the reaction conditions.
data.claim_x: An authentic sample of the proposed rearrangement product was prepared by independent synthesis.
data.claim_y: The isolated unexpected product and the authentic standard gave identical NMR spectra.

data.context_html: Laboratory examination of the paint film is the next stage of the inquiry, and it turns on the dating of materials. X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy identifies the chemical elements present in a painting's pigments. Titanium white was a standard pigment in seventeenth-century Flemish painting. That Prussian blue was first synthesized only in the early eighteenth century shows that the presence of an anachronistic pigment excludes an attribution to an earlier master.
data.claim_x: X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy identifies the chemical elements present in a painting's pigments.
data.claim_y: Titanium white was a standard pigment in seventeenth-century Flemish painting.

data.context_html: Whereas an expanding focus of mortality implicates a living agent moving from tree to tree, the growth history written in the wood speaks for climate. A pressure chamber measures midday stem water potential to quantify tree water stress. Tree-ring analysis records growth reductions that coincide with documented drought years. Such measurements establish how severely the planting was dried, but they cannot name an organism.
data.claim_x: A pressure chamber measures midday stem water potential to quantify tree water stress.
data.claim_y: Tree-ring analysis records growth reductions that coincide with documented drought years.

data.context_html: Adjudication between genuine generalization and the memorization of contaminated data proceeds empirically: analysts build fresh evaluation items that cannot have been present in any training corpus, and then compare performance on those items with performance on the original benchmark. GSM8K is a benchmark of grade-school math word problems, and its standing in that role is what prompted Scale AI to construct GSM1k as a held-out replication of the GSM8K benchmark. GSM1k was built to match the difficulty distribution and format of GSM8K. The logic of the design is straightforward, since a model that has internalized the underlying competence should transfer to new items of the same kind, whereas a model that has absorbed the original items should fall away once those items are replaced.
data.claim_x: GSM8K is a benchmark of grade-school math word problems.
data.claim_y: Scale AI constructed GSM1k as a held-out replication of the GSM8K benchmark.

data.context_html: Quantitative cross-cultural comparison introduces a complication that has shaped the statistical toolkit of the discipline. Galton's problem, the difficulty of treating culturally related societies as statistically independent cases, led directly to the development of phylogenetic comparative methods, which control for shared linguistic ancestry when testing associations between cultural traits. Only with controls of that kind can a worldwide sample of societies be read as a set of informative trials rather than as a record of inherited similarity passed down within a single lineage.
data.claim_x: Galton's problem is the difficulty of treating culturally related societies as statistically independent cases.
data.claim_y: Phylogenetic comparative methods control for shared linguistic ancestry when testing associations between cultural traits.

data.context_html: The methodological demands of stylometry explain this asymmetry between the two kinds of proof. Stylometric methods commonly measure the relative frequencies of common function words, and dependence on so delicate a measure is what causes differences of genre and date of composition to distort stylometric signals. Reliable attribution requires a control corpus of texts by rival candidate authors from the same period and genre, a standard set out in the attribution handbooks. Without such a benchmark, a measured resemblance to one candidate remains uninterpretable, since the features in question may be no more characteristic of Shakespeare than of a dozen contemporaries writing in the same mode.
data.claim_x: Differences of genre and date of composition can distort stylometric signals.
data.claim_y: Reliable attribution requires a control corpus of texts by rival candidate authors from the same period and genre.

data.context_html: A third family of methods interrogates the model's own likelihoods instead of its answers. Min-K% Prob scores a sequence using the average log-probability of its least likely tokens. Perplexity on a contaminated example runs higher than perplexity on an unseen example of equal difficulty. Membership-inference scores of this kind are attractive because they require only query access, which is often all that an outside auditor has.
data.claim_x: Min-K% Prob scores a sequence using the average log-probability of its least likely tokens.
data.claim_y: Perplexity on a contaminated example is higher than perplexity on an unseen example of equal difficulty.

data.context_html: A microburst is a downburst with an outflow diameter of less than four kilometers. A macroburst is defined as a downburst with an outflow diameter of less than two kilometers; both terms recur throughout survey documentation. The radar archive supplies a second and independent line of evidence: Doppler radar velocity data can show a rotational couplet of inbound and outbound winds near a tornado, and such volume scans are reexamined frame by frame against the timing of the damage. Eyewitness accounts of funnel clouds, on the other hand, are frequently unreliable in low-visibility or nighttime conditions, which is why survey teams treat them as the weakest element in the case file.
data.claim_x: A microburst is a downburst with an outflow diameter of less than four kilometers.
data.claim_y: A macroburst is defined as a downburst with an outflow diameter of less than two kilometers.
